scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @dts/web" "npm run dev -w @dts/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dts/web && npm run lint -w @dts/api && npm run lint -w @dts/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dts/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dts/api && npm run typecheck -w @dts/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dts/shared && npm run test -w @dts/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:push -w @dts/api && npm run seed -w @dts/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dts/web && npm run build -w @dts/api
